policyPurpose: Freeze the calculation conventions that must be explicitly chosen before any Zi Wei structural calculation runtime may consume them.

requiredPolicies.label: calendar convention
requiredPolicies.decisionScope: Define the canonical calendar convention used by Zi Wei calculation. No convention may be inferred silently.

requiredPolicies.label: lunar conversion
requiredPolicies.decisionScope: Define the authoritative conversion policy between supported civil-date input and the lunar representation consumed by Zi Wei calculation.

requiredPolicies.label: leap month policy
requiredPolicies.decisionScope: Define how leap lunar months are represented and consumed by the calculation. No school-specific rule may be guessed.

requiredPolicies.label: day boundary
requiredPolicies.decisionScope: Define the exact boundary at which the Zi Wei calculation date changes, including any timezone dependency.

requiredPolicies.label: birth-hour boundary
requiredPolicies.decisionScope: Define the canonical mapping from birth time to the Zi Wei hour segment, including treatment of exact boundaries.

requiredPolicies.label: palace construction
requiredPolicies.decisionScope: Define the canonical palace-construction system and ordering consumed by the structural runtime.

requiredPolicies.label: main-star system
requiredPolicies.decisionScope: Define the authoritative main-star system and placement convention. The runtime may not merge incompatible systems.

requiredPolicies.label: auxiliary-star scope
requiredPolicies.decisionScope: Define which auxiliary stars belong to the canonical calculation scope and which are explicitly excluded or deferred.

requiredPolicies.label: transformation scope
requiredPolicies.decisionScope: Define the canonical transformation system and the exact transformation entities admitted into calculation scope.

requiredPolicies.label: dynamic-period scope
requiredPolicies.decisionScope: Define which dynamic-period layers are calculation-authoritative in v1 and which remain outside the initial runtime scope.
